title: Platform checklist: master-detail body-tables item still states the old overview order
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Follow-up of #35742 (PR #35824, ADR note PR #35845). Found during the seat's contract review of #35845. #35701, the planned home for the other stale records-forms.json prose, is unclaimed in `pm:queue`, so this is a separate card.

## Problem
The platform checklist item `records-forms.master-detail-body-tables` in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` still states the old overview order and cites the 2026-11-19 ADR-0035 amendment. After #35824 the details column reads: header strip, the field sections drawn open, the body tables, then the trailing closed sections (ADR-0035 note of 2026-11-20, #35845). Stale lines on `main`:
- ~7210 `title`: "… a table in the record overview by default: above the field sections, …"
- ~7236 a step `clause`: "the Tasks table is drawn in the overview's left column, under the header strip's stage bar and key fields and above the first field section"
- ~7260 a step `clause`: "the drawer draws the same overview: the Tasks table above the field sections"

## Done when
- The item's title and both clauses state the new order: after the open field sections, and before trailing closed sections.
- The item's rulings or sources cite #35742 and the 2026-11-20 ADR-0035 note next to the 11-19 amendment.
- `records-forms.json` validates under the checklist's own schema and lint. No other item changes.

## Not in scope
- The other stale prose planned for #35701 (spec migration entry).
- Running the item. Its next run records whatever it finds.
